description.value: Amethyst is a Scandinavian-inspired deluxe cottage at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness retreat set on 20 acres of forested land on Bowen Island, reachable by a 20-minute ferry from Horseshoe Bay. It is one of three gemstone-named deluxe cottages, sleeping 1-2 guests with a covered cedar porch overlooking a maple and alder grove. Every stay includes daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation sessions, giving the property a structured retreat character rather than a drop-in lodging feel.

address.value: 720 Gardner Lane, Bowen Island, BC V0N 1G2

Contact details (address, phone) were sourced from the website footer since OSM carries none.
